title: Happiness
simplified_paragraphs: 一对夫妻结婚一年了，妻子是一个很天真的人，在生活中她给丈夫带来了很多快乐的时光和记忆。
有一天，丈夫因为一件小事惹妻子生气了，妻子就对着丈夫一直说：”我不喜欢你、我不喜欢你……”说了好多遍。丈夫笑着说：”老婆，你是复读机吗？”然后妻子又继续重复那句话。丈夫打断她，说：”老婆，A面读完了，该读B面了。”妻子停了一会儿后，就开始说：”我还是不喜欢你、我还是不喜欢你……”又说了好多遍。丈夫说：”老婆，复读机坏了。”这时，妻子忍不住笑了，说：”复读机没坏，不过，我原谅你了。”
其实，幸福很简单，只要我们善于在生活中经营并且去呵护彼此，幸福就在我们身边。
traditional_paragraphs: 一對夫妻結婚一年了，妻子是一個很天真的人，在生活中她給丈夫帶來了很多快樂的時光和記憶。
有一天，丈夫因為一件小事惹妻子生氣了，妻子就對著丈夫一直說：”我不喜歡你、我不喜歡你……”說了好多遍。丈夫笑著說：”老婆，你是複讀機嗎？”然後妻子又繼續重複那句話。丈夫打斷她，說：”老婆，A面讀完了，該讀B面了。”妻子停了一會兒後，就開始說：”我還是不喜歡你、我還是不喜歡你……”又說了好多遍。丈夫說：”老婆，複讀機壞了。”這時，妻子忍不住笑了，說：”複讀機沒壞，不過，我原諒你了。”
其實，幸福很簡單，只要我們善於在生活中經營並且去呵護彼此，幸福就在我們身邊。

english_paragraphs: A couple had been married for a year. The wife was rather innocent and had brought her husband many happy moments and memories.

One day, the husband upset his wife over something small. She kept saying to him, “I don’t like you. I don’t like you…” After she had repeated it many times, he laughed and said, “Honey, are you a tape recorder?” She went right on repeating herself. He interrupted her: “Honey, side A is finished. It’s time for side B.” She paused for a moment, then began, “I still don’t like you. I still don’t like you…” Again, she said it many times. Her husband said, “Honey, the tape recorder is broken.” At that, she couldn’t help laughing. “The tape recorder isn’t broken,” she said. “But I forgive you.”
Happiness is actually simple. If we take care of our relationship and look after each other, happiness is right beside us.
english_full:
A couple had been married for a year. The wife was rather innocent and had brought her husband many happy moments and memories.

One day, the husband upset his wife over something small. She kept saying to him, “I don’t like you. I don’t like you…” After she had repeated it many times, he laughed and said, “Honey, are you a tape recorder?” She went right on repeating herself. He interrupted her: “Honey, side A is finished. It’s time for side B.” She paused for a moment, then began, “I still don’t like you. I still don’t like you…” Again, she said it many times. Her husband said, “Honey, the tape recorder is broken.” At that, she couldn’t help laughing. “The tape recorder isn’t broken,” she said. “But I forgive you.”

Happiness is actually simple. If we take care of our relationship and look after each other, happiness is right beside us.
